column1: # Expected mentions for pt-*.md (0.7 task 0.2). Frozen after gate G3. Written from the specs, not from code:
# docs/ROADMAP-universe.md 1.2 and docs/PLAN-0.7.md Q22-Q29 (accents fold before stemming, Q23).
# Columns, tab separated: file, line, text, entry.
#   line   1-based line of the mention in the file (where it starts).
#   text   the raw source from the first letter of the mention to its last letter, in order of position;
#          \n stands for a line break. Link syntax and emphasis marks inside the span are kept.
#   entry  the id in entries.tsv, or - when that text must not match any entry.
# The #scope lines name the scopes a file loads (default base).
